title: Kavacha Layout
description: Persisted UI layout: where panels live, their sizes, and which elements are hidden. Edited visually in the Customization Studio; stored per profile and syncable.

tabStyle.description: Horizontal tabs are Kavacha's default look (zen.tabs.vertical=false); vertical is one toggle away. "arc" (patch 0058) is the vertical layout with an Arc-style presentation: it sets the same zen.tabs.vertical pref as "vertical" and additionally selects the kavacha-arc-tabs chrome layer.

hiddenElements.description: Ids of chrome elements the user has hidden via the Studio.

widgets.description: Dashboard widget ids, in display order (patch 0057). Empty or absent means the widget host's built-ins in their declared order; unknown ids are ignored, since a widget disappears when its marketplace component is uninstalled.

componentSizes.description: Per-component size overrides in pixels, keyed by component id.
